method: Targeted primary-source methods/limitations review; focused appendix inspection, not a claim to exhaustive full-paper reading

entries.title: Beyond Accuracy: Behavioral Testing of NLP Models with CheckList
entries.data_language_labels: English sentiment, duplicate-question detection, machine comprehension; capability-specific expected behavior.
entries.method: Minimum-functionality, invariance, and directional tests; empirical model tests and user study.
entries.result: Behavioral tests expose failures hidden by aggregate benchmark accuracy.
entries.limitations: Task-specific expectations need validation; neither moral reasoning nor JEP evaluation.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Use joint criterion-specific invariance and sensitivity; do not claim perturbation testing itself as novelty.
entries.decisive_experiment: Expert freezes which perturbations preserve each harm criterion, then held-out families test both invariance and required changes.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: Evaluating Models’ Local Decision Boundaries via Contrast Sets
entries.data_language_labels: Expert-authored contrast examples for ten NLP tasks; original and modified task labels.
entries.method: Small meaningful label-changing changes; contrast consistency requires all members correct.
entries.result: Models degrade on local contrast sets despite original-test performance.
entries.limitations: Local edits need expert checks; no Colombian testimony or harm/reparation criterion ground truth.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: A JEP contribution must concern validated criteria and evidence status, not simply contrasts.
entries.decisive_experiment: Freeze criterion-switch and epistemic-status contrasts before model outputs; report all-members success per family.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: The Hitchhiker’s Guide to Testing Statistical Significance in Natural Language Processing
entries.data_language_labels: Survey of NLP papers and significance tests; not a new training dataset.
entries.method: Matches test assumptions to metric and design; discusses dependence and multiple testing.
entries.result: Dependent examples and inappropriate tests undermine significance interpretation.
entries.limitations: Does not supply a JEP-specific hierarchical estimator or prove small-sample reliability.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Family/transcript-clustered uncertainty is an application proposed here; 48 variants are not 48 independent cases.
entries.decisive_experiment: Paired resampling at held-out source/family level; present raw per-family changes and predeclared primary comparison.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: An Empirical Investigation of Statistical Significance in NLP
entries.data_language_labels: NLP system comparisons including parsing, with in-domain and Brown out-of-domain evaluation.
entries.method: Paired bootstrap and empirical relationship of significance to improvement.
entries.result: In-domain significance does not guarantee improvement under changed data distribution.
entries.limitations: Task-specific numerical thresholds cannot be transferred to JEP; bootstrap does not remove leakage.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Fresh transcript/source hold-outs matter beyond more synthetic rows.
entries.decisive_experiment: Evaluate locked systems on a new transcript/source distribution; report transfer alongside within-fixture intervals.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: Deduplicating Training Data Makes Language Models Better
entries.data_language_labels: C4, RealNews, LM1B, Wiki40B; corpus text and train-validation overlap.
entries.method: Exact substring and near-duplicate detection; overlap analysis and deduplicated model comparisons.
entries.result: Demonstrates material duplication/overlap and benefits of deduplicating training data.
entries.limitations: Unknown pretraining corpora prevent proof that a frozen encoder never saw public testimony.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Audit transcript, source, family and paraphrase overlap rather than only row IDs.
entries.decisive_experiment: Group all related source spans/transformations before splitting; compare fresh-source performance and retain overlap diagnostics.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: The “Problem” of Human Label Variation: On Ground Truth in Data, Modeling and Evaluation
entries.evidence_type: Published position/synthesis, not original outcome trial
entries.data_language_labels: Prior annotation/modeling/evaluation examples; no new JEP labels.
entries.method: Distinguishes meaningful human variation from annotation error and discusses preserving distributions.
entries.result: Argues single aggregated labels can erase relevant variation.
entries.limitations: Normative methodological synthesis; not evidence a particular disagreement model helps JEP.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Keep assessor interpretations, criterion and reasons; do not force harm or restoration into universal consensus.
entries.decisive_experiment: Multiple independent assessors label evidence spans and partial orders; separate factual ambiguity from theoretical disagreement.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: Retrieval Evaluation with Incomplete Information
entries.data_language_labels: TREC-8/TREC-10 retrieval judgments, experimentally degraded relevance pools.
entries.method: bpref compares judged relevant/nonrelevant documents without treating every unjudged document as nonrelevant.
entries.result: More robust system comparison under incomplete judgments in tested settings.
entries.limitations: Pooling assumptions can fail for novel systems; robustness does not identify all missed relevant documents or corpus recall.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Report judged-pool ranking separately from corpus-wide recall; use independent relevance audits.
entries.decisive_experiment: Pool diverse systems plus probability-sampled omissions; exhaustively annotate at least one held-out transcript for bounded recall.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: SelectiveNet: A Deep Neural Network with an Integrated Reject Option
entries.data_language_labels: CIFAR-10, SVHN, cats/dogs and concrete regression; supervised task labels.
entries.method: Joint prediction/selection objective with coverage constraint; selective-risk evaluation.
entries.result: Demonstrates risk/coverage tradeoffs and trained selection on tested tasks.
entries.limitations: Vision/regression findings do not validate legal retrieval abstention or turn cosine into calibrated probability.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Any abstention claim must disclose coverage and whom it excludes.
entries.decisive_experiment: Compare systems at matched coverage; retain uncertain testimony for review while separately abstaining from unsupported assertions.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: Reasoning over Public and Private Data in Retrieval-Based Systems
entries.data_language_labels: CONCURRENTQA mixes public Wikipedia and private-distribution emails; model trained on HotpotQA.
entries.method: Split iterative retrieval across privacy scopes; §6 selective answering based on top-k softmax confidence.
entries.result: Risk-coverage behavior differs across distributions and privacy restrictions.
entries.limitations: Question answering and privacy scopes differ from Colombian testimony and expert harm relevance.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Selective prediction and domain-stratified risk/coverage already appear in retrieval research.
entries.decisive_experiment: Assess coverage/risk separately by hearing, source type, criterion and epistemic status rather than only pooled averages.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: COUNTERMEM: Counterfactual Evaluation of Non-Parametric Memory Use in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
entries.data_language_labels: RAGBench, ExpertQA, DelucionQA; intervention expectations and human detector audit.
entries.method: Fixed RAG configuration; retrieved-state deletion, update and contradiction; behavioral transition profiles and pipeline traces.
entries.result: Finds evidence-binding failures not captured by observational faithfulness scores.
entries.limitations: Payloads LLM-synthesized; limited human detector validation; behavioral/pipeline-level, not internal mechanism.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Generic evidence sensitivity is occupied prior art; JEP needs expert source/criterion-grounded labels and representation-specific evidence.
entries.decisive_experiment: Expert-curate legally meaningful evidence edits; fixed model/prompt; test retrieval relevance separately from assertion support and internal geometry.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence

entries.title: Beyond Epistemic Collapse: Disagreement-Aware Scientific Retrieval-Augmented Generation
entries.data_language_labels: 989-paper corpus across five contested scientific domains; disagreement benchmark and human evaluation.
entries.method: Adversarial retrieval, claim-level disagreement graph, multi-view synthesis; contradiction and viewpoint measures.
entries.result: Reports stronger contradiction/viewpoint preservation, with strong structured-prompt controls recovering much coverage.
entries.limitations: Own-team benchmark/metric design; strict call/token-matched own-strategy control absent; metric-direction flaws documented.
entries.jep_gap_or_application: Disagreement-preserving RAG is not novel; JEP criteria, testimony and reparation may create a narrower question.
entries.decisive_experiment: Matched token/call/annotation budgets and independent experts test whether explicit criterion/evidence structure beats structured prompting.
entries.gap_confidence: Moderate for bounded JEP-specific applicability; no claim of global absence
